name: Aracatexas Residential Assets v2

processing.grid_band_repair: linear interpolation across detected guide bands
processing.background_removal: 8-connected flood removal of light neutral background pixels, followed by object silhouette masks
processing.repeatable_textures: offset seam blending, no mirrored quadrants

limitations: The source references mix angled-front and top-down camera views; keep these groups separate.
Object crops marked as structural modules intentionally retain their rectangular construction surface.
The first pass removes connected bright neutral backgrounds and repairs reported guide bands; remaining edge halos must be reviewed visually.
The package is not wired into Phaser yet; lot footprint, draw order, scale and collision integration are still pending.
